deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a printed bookseller's form, an 'Interims-Nota' (provisional invoice or delivery note), filled in by hand.

Issuer: Deuerlich'sche Buchhandlung, Göttingen.
Recipient: 'Herr Professor Riemann'.
Date: Göttingen, 30 June 1860.

The printed delivery options are 'als Fortsetzung' (as a continuation), 'auf Bestellung' (on order) and 'zur geneigten Ansicht' (on approval). All three are struck through, and a handwritten word is written above them. The word is hard to read; it may refer to subscription.

The handwritten heading reads 'Im Auftrage der Verlagshandlung': the item was supplied on behalf of the publisher.

There is one item: 1 copy of 'Accessionen der königl. Univ. Bibliothek 1859'. This is the list of acquisitions of the Royal University Library at Göttingen for 1859. The price is 0 Rthlr 15 (silver or good) Groschen, i.e. half a Thaler under the 30-Groschen-per-Thaler system then in use.

The printed closing reads 'Zu gefälligen Aufträgen hält sich bestens empfohlen, achtungsvoll & ergebenst' (a standard formula offering further service). A pencil folio number '75' appears at top right.

The document's interest is biographical: it shows Riemann, as a professor at Göttingen, receiving the university library's accession list in mid-1860. It has no mathematical content to reconstruct.

results.what: Bookseller's invoice to Riemann for the 1859 accession list of the Göttingen University Library (15 Groschen), dated 30 June 1860

deep.surprise_reason: A routine bookseller's receipt with no mathematical content. It is of minor biographical interest only, documenting Riemann's acquisition of the library accession list.

checkable.asserts: 15 Groschen equals half a Thaler under the 30-Groschen Thaler (valid in Hanover from 1858).

transcription_corrections: The handwritten word above the struck-through options is not clearly 'Zahlungsabnahme'. It is illegible in detail and possibly relates to subscription or continuation; mark it as uncertain.
The printed column header next to 'Rthlr.' appears to be 'Sgr.' with a handwritten overstrike or alteration (possibly to 'Ggr.'). It should be noted as altered.
A pencil folio number '75' appears at top right and is omitted from the transcription.
The year is printed '18' with a handwritten '60', giving 30/6 1860. The amount '15' sits in the Groschen column with a dot in the Thaler column, meaning 0 Rthlr.
